# Spec — session revoke

## Concepts
### Session Vault
A per-user collection of active sessions stored in Postgres.
### Magic Link
A single-use token mailed to the user to authenticate without a password.

## User Stories
### Logged-in user revokes a session from a second device
Actor: authenticated user with ≥2 sessions. Want: end session on device B from device A. So that: a lost device cannot keep reading their inbox.

## Decisions
### Use Postgres for sessions
We use Postgres for sessions.

## Modules
### Session vault module
Interface: create, revoke, valid. Implementation in src/auth/session.py:42.

## Deferrals

Deferred: TBD.
